thread:
Isha: FYI Catalyst Cloud is lining up a POC and wants to bring their internal family (catalyst-14b-v2). Requirements: low-latency streaming chat, function-calls, 50k token KV sessions, EU residency + customer-managed KMS. Can we triage compatibility quickly?
Marco: Good flag. Do they have a HF repo or will they push weights to our secure S3? Any notes about tokenizer or special ops?
Isha: They prefer S3. Tokenizer: custom BPE + extra special tokens for system prompts. Also mentioned fused attention kernels.
Yvonne: Custom BPE means we need to validate merges and vocab. Special tokens ok but we need to confirm IDs. Fused attention may map to grouped-query or custom causal kernels  need to run our kernel-compat scanner.
Rex: For 14B: recommend variants fp16, q4_kv. If they want max throughput, int8 experiments possible but need accuracy eval. Streaming + function-calls supported by our api; ensure the model emits well-formed JSON for structured outputs.
Isha: They also asked about model provenance questions for infosec. Will share a vendor questionnaire and expect answers on model training data, PII, and retention.
Marco: Action plan: 1) request S3 presign + tokenizer files + manifest 2) run compat scan (tokenizer, attention type, layernorm) 3) recommend catalog variants + perf ballpark 4) 48h Dedicated canary if they opt for reserved pool.
Yvonne: For KV at 50k tokens we must validate sharded KV correctness and memory pressure. Our runtime can support long-context via segmented attention or sliding-window mix; we'll note memory footprints per GPU type.
Rex: Quick pricing delta: fp16 on H100 ~ baseline; q4_kv ~2.1x cost savings, expect +10-25ms/token overhead. Dedicated reserved capacity reduces variance on p95 and is better for SLA-driven customers.
OnboardBot: created ticket ONB-236000 (steps: ingest weights -> tokenizer check -> compat-scan -> variant build -> 48h canary -> KMS/residency signoff).
Isha: Can we give them a sample curl showing streaming + function-calls for the recommended q4_kv variant? They want it for devs to smoke test.
Marco: Sample below (we'll replace model_id after variant build):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"catalyst-14b-v2-q4_kv","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"List top errors from last deploy"}],"functions":[{"name":"create_ticket","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string"}}}}]}'
```
Yvonne: Assignments: @Marco -> compat scan + variant recommendation, @Yvonne -> tokenizer and kernel checks + perf estimation, @Rex -> pricing/commercial, @Isha -> customer coord & questionnaire.
Isha: I'll ask Catalyst for S3 link and completed questionnaire now. Also looping in Legal for EU residency clause.
Rex: One more customer question: can we hot-swap variants mid-session (fp16 <-> q4_kv) to optimize cost vs latency?
Marco: We support variant routing with graceful fallback, but hot-swap requires warmup and a brief routing update. Recommend canary + scheduled cutover rather than instantaneous swap.
Yvonne: While we wait for weights, I'll run a synthetic against a comparable open model to get baseline numbers for 14B. Gives client an estimate.
OnboardBot: noted infosec owner required. Add @Yvonne to KMS review.
Isha: Thanks team  I'll update Catalyst with the onboarding steps and expected 2 business day turnaround for initial compat feedback after weights arrive. :rocket:
